headings.description: Used for all headlines, providing a modern touch with native Khmer support. Include via Google Fonts.

body.description: Clean, highly readable font for dense UI elements and longer Khmer translations.

visual_enhancers.spacing: Use generous padding (e.g., p-6 or p-8) for containers on public pages. Dashboard should be dense but readable (p-4).
visual_enhancers.borders: Subtle 1px borders (border-gray-200) rather than heavy drop shadows.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Very soft, ambient shadows for floating elements only (e.g., bottom cart bar, dropdowns). Dashboard cards should be flat with borders.
visual_enhancers.radii: Consistent rounded-lg (8px) or rounded-xl (12px) across all cards, buttons, and images.
visual_enhancers.animation: Restrained. Micro-interactions on hover (opacity/bg color shift). No decorative loaders that delay ordering.

layouts.landing_page: Bento-style features, sticky header (must have solid/blur background, never completely transparent), generous hero spacing, interactive sample menu element.
layouts.mobile_menu: Mobile-first, max-w-md mx-auto or full width on mobile, category tabs, vertical list of food cards, sticky bottom cart summary.
layouts.dashboard: Plain working-tool interface. Sidebar navigation (w-64), white main content area, plain tables. No glassmorphism, no excessive gradients.

components.buttons: Pill-shaped or rounded-lg. Primary uses Terracotta, Secondary uses Outline.
components.cards: Flat, 1px border, no shadow for dashboard. Soft shadow for landing page.
components.inputs: Standard shadcn/ui styles but with rounded-md and focus ring using Terracotta.
components.kanban_board: Columns for order statuses with distinct colored header indicators.
components.dropdowns: Must have solid backgrounds. DO NOT use complete transparent backgrounds.

food_hero.description: Close-up ramen, used for main landing page hero or sample menu item.

food_burger.description: Burger combo for sample menu item.

qr_table.description: Context image for 'How it works' section - Scanning QR code.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all React files use .js extension since this is a CRA setup without TypeScript.
Dashboard must not feel like a consumer app; use plain flat tables, sidebars, and minimal styling for pure efficiency.
For translations or text, simulate Khmer/English mixed content where appropriate.
Add data-testid attributes to all interactive elements for robust testing.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy, but avoid excessive glassmorphism.
Do not center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }).
Do not apply universal transitions (transition: all).
Include data-testid on critical UI pieces.
Never use purely transparent backgrounds for overlays, sticky headers, or dropdowns.
